questions.q: What does Beck define integrity as?
questions.why: Beck says integrity originally meant "to be whole" or "intact."

questions.q: Which literary work inspires Beck's four‑step process?
questions.why: The overview notes Beck was inspired by Dante's The Divine Comedy.

questions.q: What is the first step in the Dark Wood metaphor?
questions.why: Beck says the first step to emerge is to finally acknowledge you're lost.

questions.q: Which animal represents panic in Beck's model?
questions.why: The text lists the terrifying lion as representing panic.

questions.q: What does aligning thoughts and actions lead to, according to Beck?
questions.why: When thoughts and actions fully align, you are in Paradise.
